---
title: "Research"
---

My research develops statistical and information-theoretic tools for plant breeding: how to choose better genotypes from noisy multi-environment trials and genomic data, and how to make those choices interpretable for breeders.

Full and up-to-date list: [ORCID 0009-0003-9162-8396](https://orcid.org/0009-0003-9162-8396)
